tail_para: As for Titus, after the battle he made the appropriate arrangements regarding the prisoners and the rest of the spoils, and then proceeded toward Larisa. —
head_para: [...] in general, by the greed of the Aetolians over the spoils [...] or because he did not wish, having driven Philip from power, to leave the Aetolians as masters of the Greeks.
